verdict.rationale: Docs show a generic multi-platform build pipeline (cooking/packaging/deploying to native platform formats via -targetplatform=<Plat1>+<Plat2>, UAT automation) and community evidence of exporting to HTML5, implying one project can target multiple platforms from the same source. However, there is no explicit documentation or community confirmation of console-specific export or the console-partner licensing process referenced in the story. missing for 10: explicit console platform export/partner-licensing evidence, independent confirmation of a single project shipping simultaneously to desktop/mobile/console.
